title: Split frontend filter CSS by shared surface and type
description: Refactor assets/css/eit-frontend.css into bounded CSS modules for base layout, fields, buttons, range, rating, options, chips, sort, pagination, and states.
objective: Reduce the 683-line frontend CSS surface before adding more filter-type visual controls.
expected_outputs: Frontend CSS module map through assets/css/eit-frontend.css ordered imports
CSS modules by shared surface and filter type under assets/css/filter-controller/
Stable selector and variable contracts preserved by mechanical extraction
acceptance_criteria: Existing selectors and CSS variables remain available.
Range, Rating, fields, options, sort, and pagination do not visually regress by extraction alone.
Each CSS module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: CSS brace check passes through the Filter Controller robustness harness with imported stylesheet resolution.
php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes and no longer reports assets/css/eit-frontend.css.
Concatenated CSS modules match the previous eit-frontend.css content except trailing newline in the temp comparison.
./scripts/wp.sh eval-file wp-content/plugins/elementor-implementation-toolkit/scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php passes with 49 passed, 0 failed, and 6 Guilherme-owned visual QA skips.
Plugin commit e3970e0 pushed to origin/main.
Guilherme QA remains owner for broad visual review after focused smoke.

budgets.context_budget: frontend CSS, assets enqueue, widget markup
budgets.validation_budget: CSS brace, robustness, line budget, visual smoke

risks: Cascade order can change during extraction.
Responsive constraints can regress if shared layout variables move incorrectly.
Visual QA can become expensive if extraction and feature changes are mixed.
